items.stem: What do we know about this year's Nobel prizes from the news report?

choices.text: The three researchers shared evenly the Nobel prize.
choices.zh: 三位研究人员平均分享了诺贝尔奖。

choices.text: The three winners studied the same subject.
choices.zh: 三位获奖者研究了相同的课题。

choices.text: This year's first Nobel prize was awarded for medicine.
choices.zh: 今年的首个诺贝尔奖授予了医学领域。

choices.text: All of the Nobel prizes have been made public.
choices.zh: 所有诺贝尔奖都已公布。

items.stem: How is Youyou Tu's treatment different from Campbell and Omura's?

choices.text: Youyou Tu's treatment is more hi-tech.
choices.zh: 屠呦呦的治疗方法更高科技。

choices.text: Youyou Tu's treatment is more traditional.
choices.zh: 屠呦呦的治疗方法更传统。

choices.text: Youyou Tu focuses on roundworm-caused infections.
choices.zh: 屠呦呦专注于蛔虫引起的感染。

choices.text: Youyou Tu invented a completely new therapy.
choices.zh: 屠呦呦发明了一种全新的疗法。

items.stem: What does the news report mainly discuss?

choices.text: NASA sent a new Mars lander.
choices.zh: NASA发射了一个新的火星着陆器。

choices.text: Different soil samples were studied.
choices.zh: 研究了不同的土壤样本。

choices.text: Scientists revealed a new space theory.
choices.zh: 科学家们揭示了一个新的太空理论。

choices.text: Liquid water has been found on Mars.
choices.zh: 在火星上发现了液态水。

items.stem: What are scientists going to announce today, according to the news?

choices.text: Mars is not as dry as what we used to think.
choices.zh: 火星不像我们过去认为的那样干燥。

choices.text: Mars could support life at the moment.
choices.zh: 火星目前可以支持生命。

choices.text: They have found living things on Mars.
choices.zh: 他们在火星上发现了生物。

choices.text: Soil samples from Mars are the same as those of the Earth.
choices.zh: 来自火星的土壤样本与地球的土壤样本相同。

items.stem: By whom was the woman victim shot?

choices.text: A kidnapper.
choices.zh: 一名绑架者。

choices.text: Her rival.
choices.zh: 她的情敌。

choices.text: Her 4-year-old son.
choices.zh: 她4岁的儿子。

choices.text: Her drunken husband.
choices.zh: 她醉酒的丈夫。

choices.text: She is brutal in nature.

choices.text: She is a die-hard racist.
choices.zh: 她是顽固的种族主义者。

choices.text: She loves shooting and killing.
choices.zh: 她热爱射击和杀戮。

choices.text: She is a firm gun-rights supporter.

items.stem: What was said about Florida law according to the news?

choices.text: It is against the law to own a gun.
choices.zh: 拥有枪支是违法的。

choices.text: Women are not allowed to possess a gun.
choices.zh: 女性不允许持有枪支。

choices.text: Improper storing of guns constitutes a crime.
choices.zh: 不当存放枪支构成犯罪。

choices.text: All the citizens have the right to carry a gun.
choices.zh: 所有公民都有携带枪支的权利。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from the conversation?

choices.text: He likes Sweden better than England.
choices.zh: 他更喜欢瑞典而不是英国。

choices.text: He prefers hot weather to cold weather.
choices.zh: 他更喜欢炎热的天气而不是寒冷的天气。

choices.text: He is an Englishman living in Sweden.
choices.zh: 他是一位生活在瑞典的英国人。

choices.text: He visits London nearly every winter.
choices.zh: 他几乎每个冬天都去伦敦。

items.stem: What do Swedish people complain about when they visit England in winter?

choices.text: The bad weather.
choices.zh: 糟糕的天气。

choices.text: The gloomy winter.
choices.zh: 阴郁的冬季。

choices.text: The cold houses.
choices.zh: 寒冷的房屋。

choices.text: The long night.
choices.zh: 漫长的夜晚。

items.stem: How does the man describe the short hour of daylight around Christmas in Sweden?

choices.text: Delightful.
choices.zh: 令人愉快的。

choices.text: Painful.
choices.zh: 痛苦的。

choices.text: Depressing.
choices.zh: 令人沮丧的。

choices.text: Refreshing.
choices.zh: 令人振奋的。

items.stem: What does the man say about the Swedish people?

choices.text: They often stay up late reading.
choices.zh: 他们经常熬夜读书。

choices.text: They work hard and play hard.
choices.zh: 他们努力工作也尽情玩乐。

choices.text: They like to go camping in summer.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢在夏天去露营。

choices.text: They try to earn more and spend more.
choices.zh: 他们努力多挣钱多花钱。

choices.text: English literature.
choices.zh: 英国文学。

choices.text: Management.
choices.zh: 管理学。

choices.text: French.
choices.zh: 法语。

choices.text: Public Administration.
choices.zh: 公共行政管理。

choices.text: English teaching.

choices.text: Staff training.

choices.text: Careers guidance.
choices.zh: 职业指导。

choices.text: Psychological counselling.
choices.zh: 心理咨询。

items.stem: What does the woman share in common with the man?

choices.text: They went to the same university.
choices.zh: 他们上的是同一所大学。

choices.text: They all love to engage in management.
choices.zh: 他们都热爱从事管理工作。

choices.text: The jobs they choose are not related to their major.
choices.zh: 他们选择的工作与所学专业无关。

choices.text: They received the same job training.
choices.zh: 他们接受了相同的职业培训。

items.stem: What attracted the man to Nottingham University?

choices.text: Its generous scholarships.
choices.zh: 丰厚的奖学金。

choices.text: Its worldwide fame.
choices.zh: 享誉世界的名声。

choices.text: Its well-designed courses.
choices.zh: 精心设计的课程。

choices.text: Its pleasant environment.
choices.zh: 宜人的环境。

items.stem: What did Obcamp's speech focus on?

choices.text: Characteristics of Japanese artists.
choices.zh: 日本艺术家的特点。

choices.text: Some features of Japanese culture.
choices.zh: 日本文化的一些特征。

choices.text: The art of Japanese brush painting.
choices.zh: 日本毛笔画艺术。

choices.text: The uniqueness of Japanese art.
choices.zh: 日本艺术的独特性。

items.stem: Why do Japanese listeners sometimes close their eyes while listening to a speech?

choices.text: To calm themselves down.
choices.zh: 使自己平静下来。

choices.text: To enhance concentration.
choices.zh: 增强专注力。

choices.text: To show their impatience.
choices.zh: 表示他们的不耐烦。

choices.text: To signal lack of interest.
choices.zh: 表明缺乏兴趣。

items.stem: What does the speaker try to explain?

choices.text: How listeners in different cultures show respect.
choices.zh: 不同文化中的听众如何表示尊重。

choices.text: How speakers can win approval from the audience.
choices.zh: 说话者如何赢得听众的认可。

choices.text: How speakers can misunderstand the audience.
choices.zh: 说话者如何误解听众。

choices.text: How different Western and Eastern art forms are.
choices.zh: 西方和东方艺术形式有多么不同。

items.stem: What is Chris's main responsibility at Taxalong Company?

choices.text: Directing personnel evaluation.
choices.zh: 指导人事考核。

choices.text: Buying and maintaining equipment.
choices.zh: 购买和维护设备。

choices.text: Drawing up plans for in-service training.
choices.zh: 制定在职培训计划。

choices.text: Interviewing and recruiting employees.
choices.zh: 面试和招聘员工。

items.stem: What problem did Chris encounter in his division?

choices.text: Some of his equipment was damaged in a fire.
choices.zh: 他的一些设备在火灾中损坏了。

choices.text: The training program he ran was a failure.
choices.zh: 他负责的培训项目失败了。

choices.text: Two of his workers were injured at work.
choices.zh: 他的两名员工在工作中受伤了。

choices.text: Two of his employees committed theft.
choices.zh: 他的两名员工犯了盗窃罪。

items.stem: What does Chris hope for in the near future?

choices.text: A better relationship with his boss.
choices.zh: 与上司建立更好的关系。

choices.text: Advancement to a higher position.
choices.zh: 晋升到更高的职位。

choices.text: A better-paying job in another company.
choices.zh: 在另一家公司找到薪酬更高的工作。

choices.text: Improvement in the company's management.
choices.zh: 公司管理方面的改进。

items.stem: What do we learn about Kim from the passage?

choices.text: She has more self-confidence than Chris.
choices.zh: 她比Chris更有自信。

choices.text: She works with Chris in the same division.
choices.zh: 她和Chris在同一个部门工作。

choices.text: She has more management experience than Chris.
choices.zh: 她比Chris有更多的管理经验。

choices.text: She is competing with Chris for the new job.
choices.zh: 她正在和Chris竞争这个新职位。

items.stem: Why are proverbs so important?

choices.text: They help us see the important values of a culture.
choices.zh: 它们帮助我们了解一种文化的重要价值观。

choices.text: They guide us in handling human relationships.
choices.zh: 它们指导我们处理人际关系。

choices.text: They help us express ourselves more effectively.
choices.zh: 它们帮助我们更有效地表达自己。

choices.text: They are an infinite source of human knowledge.
choices.zh: 它们是人类知识的无尽源泉。

items.stem: According to the speaker what happens to some proverbs with the passage of time?

choices.text: Their wording may become different.
choices.zh: 它们的措辞可能会变得不同。

choices.text: The values they reflect may change.
choices.zh: 它们所反映的价值观可能会改变。

choices.text: Their origins can no longer be traced.
choices.zh: 它们的起源已无法追溯。

choices.text: They may be misinterpreted occasionally.
choices.zh: 它们有时可能会被误解。

items.stem: What do we learn from the study of proverbs from around the world?

choices.text: Certain values are shared by a large number of cultures.
choices.zh: 许多文化共享某些价值观。

choices.text: Some proverbs are assuming more and more importance.
choices.zh: 一些谚语正变得越来越重要。

choices.text: Old proverbs are constantly replaced by new ones.
choices.zh: 旧谚语不断被新谚语取代。

choices.text: Certain values have always been central to a culture.
choices.zh: 某些价值观始终是一种文化的核心。
